# Flutter embedder API header

`embedder.h` is the Flutter engine's public embedder API, copied unchanged from
the Flutter SDK 3.47.7 (engine revision deb287481e3ce9468f3434937ced4240a70539ca,
`engine/src/flutter/shell/platform/embedder/embedder.h`). BSD-3-Clause, see
`LICENSE`. Used by `dena-launcher` (docs/specs/embedder.md); the engine library
itself is loaded at run time.
